status: source-derived recurrent transition fixture; not full model/state qualification
precision: oracle uses Python binary64; answers below are exact rational literals; tolerance abs=1e-12 rel=1e-12

provenance.source_lock: bench/reference/source-lock.json pins repository revision and records model-card/license hashes; the recurrent, gating, common and convolution CUDA files are local pinned-tree bytes hashed for this fixture, not separately enumerated lock inputs.

contract.input_order: For each token: key, value, already transformed decay alpha=exp(g), beta, then query for readout.
contract.update: p_r = sum_c S[r,c]*k[c]; delta_r = beta*(v[r]-alpha*p_r); S_next[r,c] = alpha*S[r,c]+delta_r*k[c].
contract.normalization_boundary: The reference has an optional Q/K L2 normalization (epsilon 1e-6 in recurrent.cuh); fixture takes normalized-or-raw k and q as explicit input and does not emulate/choose the template flag.
contract.gate_boundary: Reference gating computes g=-exp(A_log[h])*softplus(a+dt_bias[h]) and beta=sigmoid(b). Fixture takes alpha=exp(g) and beta as inputs; it does not approximate softplus/sigmoid or choose weights/biases.
contract.convolution: The inspected conv kernel establishes causal depthwise width-4 tap order [oldest history x[t-3], x[t-2], x[t-1], current x[t]] with 3 history slots and SiLU. This new oracle intentionally covers the recurrent state transition only; convolution remains a separately identified missing fixture.
